name: Speckle Sync
description: The sync job for one Speckle project: which server and project to read, which Speckle Project document to mirror into, and an append-only log of every run. Requesting a sync is an operation, which is what a processor reacts to — so the pull is triggered by the document, not by a timer. Each collaborator keeps their own Speckle access token in private local scope.

global.schema:
type SpeckleSyncState {
    serverUrl: URL
    projectId: String
    projectName: String
    targetProjectDocumentId: PHID
    status: SyncStatus!
    autoSync: Boolean!
    versionsPerModel: Int!
    maxObjectsPerVersion: Int!
    lastRequestedAt: DateTime
    lastCompletedAt: DateTime
    lastError: String
    runs: [SyncRun!]!
}

type SyncRun {
    id: OID!
    requestedAt: DateTime!
    startedAt: DateTime
    finishedAt: DateTime
    outcome: RunOutcome!
    fullResync: Boolean!
    modelsSeen: Int!
    versionsSeen: Int!
    versionsAdded: Int!
    objectsScanned: Int!
    message: String
}

enum SyncStatus {
    IDLE
    REQUESTED
    RUNNING
    FAILED
}

enum RunOutcome {
    PENDING
    SUCCESS
    FAILURE
    CANCELLED
}
global.initialValue:
{
    "serverUrl": null,
    "projectId": null,
    "projectName": null,
    "targetProjectDocumentId": null,
    "status": "IDLE",
    "autoSync": false,
    "versionsPerModel": 25,
    "maxObjectsPerVersion": 5000,
    "lastRequestedAt": null,
    "lastCompletedAt": null,
    "lastError": null,
    "runs": []
}
